sources.title: G4.5-10 Gate Amendment - Reference Brush Fidelity & Windows ARC Sync Proof v0.1
sources.content_hash_scope: normalized implementation-relevant Amendment requirements reproduced in materialized_excerpt
sources.materialized_excerpt: G4.5-09F is blocking before final G4.5 PASS. Five morphologically distinct reference brushes are required. At least one brush is live-editable. RB-03/RB-05 require real Shape/Grain materialization. V2 dab emission must be spacing-driven and sample-rate independent. Canonical Skia and Windows ARC must consume the same BrushProgram-derived primitive/resource semantics. Space toggles presentation-only dual-color diagnostics. No full Brush Studio, persistence/sync, Procreate import, WetMix, CanvasAwareRaster, new canonical schema, or Arc-owned brush semantics.

sources.title: GT-G4-5-09F - Reference Brush Fidelity Implementation Design & P31 Freeze v0.1
sources.content_hash_scope: normalized P30/P31 frozen design reproduced in materialized_excerpt
sources.materialized_excerpt: Preserve BrushDefinition v1 semantics. Reference fidelity uses BrushDefinition v2. Materialized immutable alpha resources carry stable content hashes. Common ink code composes Shape and Grain into one derived render-ready alpha resource consumed by both Skia and ARC. V2 DAB emission uses distance-based arc-length spacing and deterministic dab ordinals. ARC receives render-ready primitives/resources only. Windows uses existing Arc lifecycle and canonical-visible handoff. P32 terminates at READY_FOR_G4_5_10_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION.

sources.title: G4.5 Programmable Brush System Architecture v0.1
sources.content_hash_scope: normalized inherited architecture invariants reproduced in materialized_excerpt
sources.materialized_excerpt: Axiom owns brush semantics, prediction and canonicalization. Arc receives Axiom-generated render-ready transient representation and is not a second Brush Engine. BrushProgram is immutable, versioned and renderer-neutral. BrushRuntime emits commit and preview artifacts without directly mutating SemanticDocument. Existing FinePen, Highlighter and TexturedMarker replay semantics remain compatible. True wet pigment and new RasterStroke/MediaStroke semantics are out of scope.
